That means something is slow — maybe the *verifier* is slow on large instances (it re-checks everything with fresh solvers, using a plain Solver with `obj == value` assertions — those are SAT checks on the full model, each maybe 50-200 ms with the boolean encoding; 4 checks × (12 demands + 32 links) × 4 snapshots = 704 checks × ~100 ms = 70 s per instance!).

That's the verifier being slow, not my solver. Let me instrument: print per-instance solve time and verify time separately, and reduce the number of big instances per run.

Let me add progress printing with flush so I can see where time goes.
